svg.title: QuantumShield pipeline
svg.desc: Five stages: Scan (qs scan; inventory.json), Inventory (CycloneDX 1.6 CBOM; cbom.json), Analyze (about 30 rules; findings.json, report.md), Migrate (qs migrate, qs proxy, qs pki; plan.md, patched configs, proxies.json), Measure (qs bench, qs dashboard; bench.json, bench.md, dashboard.html). Demo run: 3 endpoints and 16 files, 27 CBOM assets, 43 findings (5 critical, 18 high), 7 config patches and 3 sidecars, 6 handshake scenarios and 5 live paths.
